source_title: Introducing the EBox: Compact Power and Resilience for Today’s Data Centers
claim_relevant_visible_text: A single AMD Genoa 48-core processor is at its heart, supported by 384GB of memory, three storage-class memory (SCM) drives, and nine 30TB NVMe SSDs.
researcher_paraphrase: VAST Data’s December 2024 EBox description specifies three SCM drives and nine 30TB NVMe SSDs in the platform.
precision_guard: The 2024 VAST page does not identify the NVMe SSD vendor, model, NAND cell type, or QLC status. Do not infer Solidigm P5336 or QLC from later VAST BOM/validation material.
authority_boundary: VAST Data is platform-primary for its own EBox configuration at the stated 2024 publication vintage; it is not primary for an unnamed SSD vendor’s product identity.
